executions.title: Improved flow: timeout then confirmed paid via original reference
executions.expected: Timeout shows "Still confirming" (never Failed); two status checks on the SAME attempt end paid; order becomes paid with only 1 chargeable attempt; settlement exception opens.

assertions.name: UI: timeout screen is "Still confirming this payment"
State A (rule A): attempt unknown, order payment_pending after timeout
Rule C: pending result creates no new chargeable attempt
Rule B: same attempt ID used for both checks (PAY-1042-01)
Rule D: paid with exactly 1 chargeable attempt
Rule 5: settlement exception opened, not silently resolved
UI: paid result offers Next customer

executions.title: Improved flow: confirmed failure unlocks exactly one safe retry
executions.expected: Customer 2 (reached from a fresh page via the customer-1 paid setup): pending → confirmed failed on the original attempt → exactly one new chargeable attempt allowed → paid on attempt 2 (PAY-1043-02); status checks never change the chargeable count.

assertions.name: timeout screen keeps attempt unknown
Queue advanced to customer 2 of 3
Attempt 1 on customer 2 creates exactly one chargeable attempt (PAY-1043-01)
Rule A/E: failure shown only after confirmation; retry offered; checks added no chargeable attempt
Rule 4: exactly one new chargeable attempt after confirmed failure; new attempt ID (PAY-1043-02)
Recovery completes paid on attempt 2 with no further chargeable attempts

observations: chargeable is a session-wide counter: the customer-1 paid setup contributes 1 before customer 2 begins.

executions.title: Baseline flow: timeout pushed as failure, blind retry creates 2nd charge
executions.expected: Documented baseline defect: timeout UI says "Payment didn’t go through" and offers retry without checking the original attempt; confirming creates a second chargeable attempt (PAY-1042-02). PASS means the baseline behaved as documented; the duplicate-prevention metric counts this as NOT prevented.

assertions.name: UI: baseline timeout copy "Payment didn’t go through"
Observation-backed: model attempt is still unknown while UI pushes retry
Baseline defect reproduced: second chargeable attempt created

observations: Baseline treats an unknown outcome as failure in copy while state stays unknown; the retry path creates a second chargeable attempt with no status check.

executions.title: Adversarial: retry attempt while original is pending is blocked
executions.expected: Tapping "Take payment" while an attempt is unresolved shows the blocked screen; no second chargeable attempt is created; attempt ID unchanged.

assertions.name: Checkout shows pending notice, not a fresh start
Rule D/4: blocked screen shown, dupBlocks incremented
No second chargeable attempt; original ID PAY-1042-01 preserved

executions.title: Adversarial: start a charge on an already-paid order (UI + direct call)
executions.expected: Paid checkout exposes no start-payment control; a direct startPayment() call is refused by the model guard; chargeable stays 1.

assertions.name: Paid checkout shows "Order paid" and exposes no start control
Direct model call startPayment() is refused (guard)

executions.title: Repeated status checks on an unresolved outcome stay pending and stable
executions.expected: Customer 3 (reached from a fresh page via paid customer 1 + confirmed-failed customer 2): two checks stay pending and open exactly one unresolved exception; a third check changes nothing (same ID, no new chargeable attempt, no duplicate exception).
